items.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以 Ubuntu 服务器和 CodeBuddy 为例，实操在腾讯云开源的 Octop 中创建托管专家，让 CodeBuddy 在指定仓库目录完成拉取、修改与提交，并接入飞书、微信等 IM 实现 7×24 小时在线响应。

en.title: Hands-on: Hosting CodeBuddy on Octop to Build a 24/7 AI Programmer
en.reason: Octop, Tencent Cloud's open-source multi-agent platform, lets you create a hosted expert that runs CodeBuddy in a designated repository directory to pull, modify and commit code, connect it to Feishu and WeChat for round-the-clock responses, and coordinate Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex without switching tools.
